## Which file do I download?

Every download also needs [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads) installed.

| You want | Windows | Linux |
|---|---|---|
| **Desktop app (GUI)**: recommended for most users | `FCPModManager-GUI-win-x64.zip` | `FCPModManager-GUI-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| Command-line (CLI) app | `FCPModUpdater-win-x64-selfcontained.zip` | `FCPModUpdater-linux-x64-selfcontained.tar.gz` |
| CLI, smaller download (needs the [.NET 10 Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download)) | `FCPModUpdater-win-x64.zip` | `FCPModUpdater-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

Already installed? Run `update-fcp-mod-manager.bat` (Windows) or `update-fcp-mod-manager.sh` (Linux) from your install folder. It updates whichever app is there.

`checksums.txt` lists the SHA-256 of every archive.
